predictions.text: I predict that the Iowa Army Ammunition Plant will conduct a significant operation tomorrow, which was postponed to allow for optimal weather conditions and mitigation measures.
I predict that a prominent individual will have their seat recounted and the final outcome of the election will be decided in favor of another prominent individual after the recount.
I predict that another Russian cargo ship will be struck by naval drones off the coast of Benghazi in the Mediterranean Sea.
I predict that the minimum wage increase from ৳12,500 to ৳30,000 will pass, but ongoing protests and clashes will continue in Gazipur, Savar, and Ashulia, with at least 100 arrests made.

I predict that between five and eleven people are killed, five others are injured, and several others are abducted in additional bandit attacks and vigilante responses in Borgu and Zamfara States, Nigeria.
I predict that a 58-year-old student dies during a hunger strike at a university in Rome, Italy, by the end of Tuesday, 1 December 2026.
I predict that the bomb threat wave will spread to at least two more German states by the end of Tuesday, 1 December 2026.

I predict that the Allied Democratic Forces insurgency will continue to target Christians in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, particularly in North Kivu and Ituri provinces, resulting in at least 140 casualties by the end of Tuesday, 1 December 2026.

I predict that the specific areas of cooperation between the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Kenya will prioritize trade and infrastructure development, with a focus on improving transportation links between the two countries.
I predict that the Kurdistan Workers' Party withdraws from additional bases in northern Iraq as part of an ongoing disarmament process aimed at ending its conflict with Turkey.
